verdict.rationale: The platform is built around first-party AI agents (Kosmos, Literature, Analysis, Precedent, Molecules) that users can hand complex research tasks to. Kosmos autonomously reads literature, writes and runs code, and produces cited reports. Tasks can be submitted, batched and retrieved later, and long-lived chat sessions keep sandbox, files and history across turns. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that delegation works as claimed, and explicit evidence of the in-product UI for delegating (most evidence covers the API client).
